message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em game the most hearts a single player can hold is **five** (if all five community cards are hearts, giving a flush).  
That player would win the pot if no one else has a higher‑ranking hand.  

If you’re asking about a particular hand you’re watching, you’d need to look at the actual cards dealt to each player to see who ended up with the most hearts.
